views.name: active_customer_credit
views.sql:
CREATE VIEW active_customer_credit AS SELECT a.*,
 a.amount-COALESCE((SELECT SUM(r.amount) FROM customer_credit_operations r WHERE r.reverses_id=a.id AND r.state='posted'),0) remaining
 FROM customer_credit_operations a WHERE a.kind='allocation' AND a.state='posted'

views.name: commission_positions
views.sql:
CREATE VIEW commission_positions AS WITH totals AS(
 SELECT r.id run_id,r.user_id,r.earned_commission,r.net_payable,
 COALESCE((SELECT SUM(amount) FROM commission_payments WHERE run_id=r.id),0) paid,
 COALESCE((SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN kind='reduction' THEN amount WHEN kind='reinstatement' THEN -amount ELSE 0 END) FROM commission_corrections WHERE run_id=r.id AND state='posted'),0) reduction,
 COALESCE((SELECT SUM(amount) FROM commission_corrections WHERE run_id=r.id AND kind='recovery' AND state='posted'),0) recovered
 FROM payroll_runs r
 ) SELECT *,earned_commission-reduction effective_commission,net_payable-reduction effective_net,paid-recovered net_paid,
 MAX(0,net_payable-reduction-paid+recovered) payable,MAX(0,paid-recovered-net_payable+reduction) recoverable FROM totals

views.name: customer_branch_access
views.sql:
CREATE VIEW customer_branch_access AS
    SELECT id customer_id,branch_id FROM customers WHERE branch_id IS NOT NULL
    UNION SELECT c.id,t.branch_id FROM customers c JOIN repair_tickets t ON t.customer_id=c.id WHERE c.branch_id IS NULL AND t.branch_id IS NOT NULL
    UNION SELECT c.id,i.branch_id FROM customers c JOIN invoices i ON i.customer_id=c.id WHERE c.branch_id IS NULL AND i.branch_id IS NOT NULL AND i.type!='purchase'
    UNION SELECT c.id,s.branch_id FROM customers c JOIN sales s ON s.customer_id=c.id WHERE c.branch_id IS NULL AND s.branch_id IS NOT NULL
    UNION SELECT c.id,p.branch_id FROM customers c JOIN payments p ON p.customer_id=c.id WHERE c.branch_id IS NULL AND p.branch_id IS NOT NULL AND p.supplier_id IS NULL
    UNION SELECT c.id,a.branch_id FROM customers c JOIN appointments a ON a.customer_id=c.id WHERE c.branch_id IS NULL AND a.branch_id IS NOT NULL

views.name: device_branch_access
views.sql:
CREATE VIEW device_branch_access AS
    SELECT id device_id,branch_id FROM devices WHERE branch_id IS NOT NULL
    UNION SELECT d.id,c.branch_id FROM devices d JOIN customers c ON c.id=d.customer_id WHERE d.branch_id IS NULL AND c.branch_id IS NOT NULL
    UNION SELECT d.id,t.branch_id FROM devices d JOIN customers c ON c.id=d.customer_id JOIN repair_tickets t ON t.device_id=d.id WHERE d.branch_id IS NULL AND c.branch_id IS NULL AND t.branch_id IS NOT NULL
    UNION SELECT d.id,a.branch_id FROM devices d JOIN customers c ON c.id=d.customer_id JOIN appointments a ON a.device_id=d.id WHERE d.branch_id IS NULL AND c.branch_id IS NULL AND a.branch_id IS NOT NULL
    UNION SELECT d.id,MIN(access.branch_id) FROM devices d JOIN customers c ON c.id=d.customer_id JOIN customer_branch_access access ON access.customer_id=c.id WHERE d.branch_id IS NULL AND c.branch_id IS NULL GROUP BY d.id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT access.branch_id)=1

views.name: effective_installments
views.sql:
CREATE VIEW effective_installments AS SELECT i.id,i.customer_id,i.invoice_id,i.ticket_id,i.seq,i.amount,i.due_date,i.reminder_days_before,i.notes,i.user_id,i.created_at,i.schedule_id,i.schedule_term_id,
 COALESCE(s.branch_id,inv.branch_id) branch_id,s.status schedule_state,i.paid_amount stored_paid_amount,i.status stored_status,i.paid_at stored_paid_at,
 CASE WHEN i.schedule_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END legacy_review,
 COALESCE(a.paid,0) paid_amount,CASE WHEN i.schedule_id IS NULL THEN 'legacy_review' WHEN COALESCE(a.paid,0)>=i.amount THEN 'paid' WHEN COALESCE(a.paid,0)>0 THEN 'partially_paid' WHEN i.due_date<date('now') THEN 'overdue' ELSE 'pending' END status,
 a.paid_at paid_at
 FROM installments i LEFT JOIN installment_schedules s ON s.id=i.schedule_id LEFT JOIN invoices inv ON inv.id=i.invoice_id
 LEFT JOIN (SELECT installment_id,SUM(paid) paid,MAX(created_at) paid_at FROM (
 SELECT installment_id,verified_amount paid,created_at FROM installment_allocation_balances
 UNION ALL SELECT installment_id,remaining,created_at FROM active_customer_credit WHERE installment_id IS NOT NULL) GROUP BY installment_id) a ON a.installment_id=i.id
 WHERE s.status='active' OR (i.schedule_id IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM installment_schedules accepted WHERE accepted.invoice_id=i.invoice_id AND accepted.status IN ('active','superseded')))

views.name: effective_invoices
views.sql:
CREATE VIEW effective_invoices AS SELECT i."id",i."number",i."customer_id",i."ticket_id",i."sale_id",i."branch_id",i."status",i."date",i."due_date",i."subtotal",i."discount",i."tax",i."notes",i."terms",i."revision",i."created_by",i."created_at",i."type",i."supplier_id",i."employee_id",i."external_number",i."confirmed_at",i."confirmed_by",i."stock_posted",i."cancelled_at",i."cancel_reason",i."client_key",i."purchase_order_id",i.total original_total,i.paid stored_paid,
 (COALESCE((SELECT SUM(p.amount-COALESCE((SELECT SUM(r.amount) FROM refunds r WHERE r.payment_id=p.id),0))
    FROM payments p WHERE p.invoice_id=i.id AND p.direction=CASE WHEN i.type='purchase' THEN 'out' ELSE 'in' END AND (p.method NOT IN ('check','cheque') OR EXISTS
  (SELECT 1 FROM checks c WHERE c.payment_id=p.id AND c.status='passed'))),0)
    + CASE WHEN CASE WHEN i.type='purchase' THEN 'out' ELSE 'in' END='in' THEN
      COALESCE((SELECT SUM(a.remaining) FROM active_customer_credit a WHERE a.invoice_id=i.id),0)
      - COALESCE((SELECT SUM(a.remaining) FROM active_customer_credit a WHERE a.source_invoice_id=i.id),0)
    ELSE 0 END) paid,
 COALESCE((SELECT SUM(c.amount) FROM credit_notes c WHERE c.invoice_id=i.id AND c.status='posted'),0) credit_total,i.total-COALESCE((SELECT SUM(c.amount) FROM credit_notes c WHERE c.invoice_id=i.id AND c.status='posted'),0) total FROM invoices i

views.name: installment_allocation_balances
views.sql:
CREATE VIEW installment_allocation_balances AS SELECT a.*,a.amount-COALESCE((SELECT SUM(amount) FROM installment_allocation_reversals WHERE allocation_id=a.id),0) remaining,
 CASE WHEN p.settled AND p.direction='in' AND p.allocated+p.credit_used<=p.amount-p.refunded THEN a.amount-COALESCE((SELECT SUM(amount) FROM installment_allocation_reversals WHERE allocation_id=a.id),0) ELSE 0 END verified_amount
 FROM installment_allocations a JOIN installment_receipt_funds p ON p.id=a.payment_id

views.name: installment_receipt_funds
views.sql:
CREATE VIEW installment_receipt_funds AS SELECT p.*,(p.method NOT IN ('check','cheque') OR EXISTS
  (SELECT 1 FROM checks c WHERE c.payment_id=p.id AND c.status='passed')) settled,
 COALESCE((SELECT SUM(amount) FROM refunds WHERE payment_id=p.id),0) refunded,
 COALESCE((SELECT SUM(remaining) FROM active_customer_credit WHERE payment_id=p.id),0) credit_used,
 COALESCE((SELECT SUM(a.amount-COALESCE((SELECT SUM(r.amount) FROM installment_allocation_reversals r WHERE r.allocation_id=a.id),0)) FROM installment_allocations a WHERE a.payment_id=p.id),0) allocated
 FROM payments p

views.name: invoice_settlements
views.sql:
CREATE VIEW invoice_settlements AS
 SELECT p.invoice_id,p.direction,p.amount-COALESCE((SELECT SUM(r.amount) FROM refunds r WHERE r.payment_id=p.id),0) amount FROM payments p WHERE (p.method NOT IN ('check','cheque') OR EXISTS
  (SELECT 1 FROM checks c WHERE c.payment_id=p.id AND c.status='passed'))
 UNION ALL SELECT source_invoice_id,'in',-remaining FROM active_customer_credit WHERE source_invoice_id IS NOT NULL
 UNION ALL SELECT invoice_id,'in',remaining FROM active_customer_credit

views.name: party_balance_events
views.sql:
CREATE VIEW party_balance_events AS
 SELECT CASE WHEN type='purchase' THEN 'supplier' ELSE 'customer' END kind,CASE WHEN type='purchase' THEN supplier_id ELSE customer_id END party_id,branch_id,total amount
 FROM effective_invoices WHERE status NOT IN ('draft','cancelled')
 UNION ALL SELECT 'customer',s.customer_id,s.branch_id,s.total FROM sales s WHERE s.status!='cancelled'
 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM invoices i WHERE i.sale_id=s.id AND i.status NOT IN ('draft','cancelled'))
 UNION ALL SELECT CASE WHEN p.direction='out' THEN 'supplier' ELSE 'customer' END,CASE WHEN p.direction='out' THEN p.supplier_id ELSE p.customer_id END,p.branch_id,-p.amount
 FROM payments p WHERE p.direction IN ('in','out') AND (p.method NOT IN ('check','cheque') OR EXISTS
  (SELECT 1 FROM checks c WHERE c.payment_id=p.id AND c.status='passed'))
 UNION ALL SELECT CASE WHEN p.direction='out' THEN 'supplier' ELSE 'customer' END,CASE WHEN p.direction='out' THEN p.supplier_id ELSE p.customer_id END,r.branch_id,r.amount
 FROM refunds r JOIN payments p ON p.id=r.payment_id WHERE p.direction IN ('in','out') AND (p.method NOT IN ('check','cheque') OR EXISTS
  (SELECT 1 FROM checks c WHERE c.payment_id=p.id AND c.status='passed'))
